compute_giou_loss_no_reduction: compute the generalized IoU loss between two sets of bounding boxes with no reduction applied
compute_giou_loss_mean_reduction: compute the mean generalized IoU loss between two sets of bounding boxes for object detection training
compute_giou_loss_sum_reduction: compute the summed generalized IoU loss between two sets of bounding boxes for batch training
compute_giou_loss_single_boxes: compute the generalized IoU loss between two single bounding boxes in XYXY format
compute_giou_loss_custom_eps: compute the generalized IoU loss between bounding boxes with a custom epsilon value to prevent division by zero
